global: This shoyu ramen boasts a rich, amber broth, topped with a soft-boiled egg, tender chashu pork, and crisp menma. Served in a blue-patterned bowl, it rests on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Dark brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, oval-shaped surface.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with blue geometric pattern and Korean text along its rim.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is golden-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
regions.egg: A whole boiled egg, pale yellow-white, smooth and glossy, oval-shaped with subtle surface variations.
regions.meat: The chashu pork slice shows layered fat and lean meat, glistening with sauce, with a slightly curled, irregular shape.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, with fibrous texture, irregular segmented shape, and glossy surface.
